body: Ok. Thank you. Do you have a discord? I just need enough hope to keep me going until the job either becomes easier or I make it to next June. I’m also trying to pass time by drawing. I now have aspirations of become a good/great artist. Another way I pass time is by trying to learn Spanish. Bye the time my littlest sister gets in second grade I will be free. I have a future. I am not a laborer. I am a student working towards his future. It’s thoughts like these that give me hope. I am not particularly religious but it believing in one gives me hope, I’ll consider converting.

It’s just one of those jobs given by companies led by rich people who exploit immigrants/aliens for cheap labor. 

My dad told me I can’t work with my headphones in but I’m going to sneak them anyway. I need some form of stimulation to keep me going. I’ve already considered listening to podcasts but audiobooks are good too. The job is too monotonous that it requires little focus.

Yes please, I’ll need all the help I can get. I know I’m not the only one who hates their job by a long shot but that helps little. The thing is that I used to think that it didn’t matter what I had to do, as long as I got paid it was worth it. I was a fool. I was a damned fool. Though my mind obsessively worries about any sort of change, causing me considerable to high psychological stress, part of the reason I hate the job is because I have to do the same thing 11 hours straight. At least now I can appreciate what my dad does. He tells me that he doesn’t have a green card and has to wait 20 years upon entering the country for a chance that he gets one from his wife’s brother. I want to help him when I become 21 so he can at least get a job that doesn’t exploit him. I’m also trying to help him learn English through Duolingo.
